posts.name: kitmehsu
posts.cooked:
So I think i've gotten most of the work done on the roll20 board, and since the playtest wasn't recorded due to issues, I wanted to do a pick up game via twitch stream tomorrow night so I can get game footage and just show off the work I did.

Where: http://www.twitch.tv/kitmehsu

When: 6pm EDT Mar 18

What: A streamed game of Sentinel Tactics through the online service roll20, where the players will be sent invites from those watching the stream.  The set-up will be the same as PAX-South, with a potental second game pending interest/time

Who: Anyone can join the stream, though it will help to have registered with roll20 if you want to try and join the game.

Technically this is seperate from the invite tests, so even if you're part of it, this will actually be part of different campaign so the links will be to a different version.  Also, for a teaser of whats to come, I've attached a screenshot of just what i've done in the game.
